Mike.support: Hey team — customer reported intermittent 401s on /v1/generate plus P95 spikes ~1s in the EU region. They sent a raw curl repro but it contains cleartext PII. Need a sanitized repro + request IDs for logs so we can correlate. :eyes:
Anika.sre: Can you drop the request_id from their headers and a few example timestamps? we'll need request IDs to pull traces. also what's the customer org id?
Mike.support: Org: acct_9XyZ, original message ts 2026-04-12T15:22:10Z. They attached this curl (raw):

```bash
curl https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-live-USERSECRET" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"xlarge-v1","prompt":"Invoice for John Smith, SSN 123-45-6789, charge $1,234.56"}'
```

Mike.support: We cannot forward that raw. Need guidance on minimal scrub and what to ask them to replace with placeholders.
Sara.privacy: Ask them to replace all names, SSNs, emails, phone numbers with canonical tokens like <NAME_1>, <SSN>, <EMAIL_1>. Also request they keep structure and lengths (e.g., keep numeric groups) so repro remains realistic. Provide a one-liner sed/jq they can run client-side.
Jordan.eng: For correlation we still need the request IDs returned in response headers (x-rd-request-id) and the timestamps of the failing calls. If they can't share request ids, ask for server-side logs matched to the time range. Without ids it's much harder.
Mike.support: Good. Drafting an ask — want to confirm the exact scrub commands we should give them.
Anika.sre: Send them this minimal script to anonymize locally before upload:

```bash
# replace emails, names, SSNs and tokens with placeholders
cat raw_payload.json \
  | sed -E 's/[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}/<EMAIL_1>/g' \
  | sed -E 's/[0-9]{3}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{4}/<SSN>/g' \
  | sed -E 's/[0-9]{1,3}([,\.][0-9]{3})*(\.[0-9]+)?/<NUM>/g' \
  > scrubbed_payload.json
```

Anika.sre: And this one to strip auth tokens from curl and keep placeholders:

```bash
# rewrite Authorization header to placeholder
sed -E "s/-H \"Authorization: Bearer [^\"]+\"/-H \"Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED_TOKEN>\"/g" original_curl.sh > scrubbed_curl.sh
```

Sara.privacy: Also ask them to pseudonymize names consistently, e.g., map John Smith -> NAME_1 across payloads, so we can still detect prompt-cache matches. They can send the mapping separately and we store it encrypted if needed.
Mike.support: I'll send that in DM plus request: (1) scrubbed curl, (2) scrubbed payload, (3) x-rd-request-id values, (4) three timestamps around failures, (5) region + model.
Jordan.eng: If they can run a minimal debug bundle, ask them to include sequence of request ids and the response header dump. Provide the command to collect headers only:

```bash
curl -i https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED_TOKEN>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d @scrubbed_payload.json | head -n 50 > resp_headers.txt
```

Mike.support: One more: They reported spikes correlated with auth failures. Could be short-lived token expiry. Ask them to check local clock skew and if they use short-lived creds.
Anika.sre: I'll pre-check infra for any auth rollback around those timestamps. If we see nothing, we'll request the sanitized bundle and escalate to Platform.
Devex-bot: Reminder: attach this thread checklist to the ticket: [scrub-instructions.md], [debug-bundle-form], [minimal-curl-template].
Mike.support: Sending message to the customer now. I'll paste the exact scripts and include a sample sanitized example for clarity. Will update here once they respond. :lock:
